name: Swift Step (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Agility Patron

Major Hex: The witch teleports a short distance. As a move action, the witch can teleport up to 30 feet + 5 feet for every 2 levels the witch possesses beyond 10th (to a maximum of 55 feet at 20th level). A witch can bring along a willing creature she touches by reducing her teleportation distance by half.
